pack_protobuf_message: pack a protobuf message into an Any message with a custom type URL prefix
unpack_any_message: unpack an Any message into an existing protobuf message instance and return success
unpack_as_message_type: unpack an Any message as a specific message type or raise a TypeError on mismatch
get_type_name: get the type name string from an Any message for inspection or logging
check_any_type: check if an Any message matches a given protobuf descriptor type
